reference_contour.description: Extract one connected subject's outer silhouette and place a viewport guide. Set preview_only for a read-only measurement.
reference_contour.label: Calibrated Reference Contour

parameters.anchor: Normalized [right, up] inside the calibration frame, after flips. Default: [.5, .5].
parameters.anchor_to_object: Add the target object's world origin to center.
parameters.bridge_px: Square closing radius (0–8 pixels) to bridge narrow mask gaps.
parameters.calibration_rect_px: [left, top, right, bottom] using source pixel boundaries, or null to use the contour bounds.
parameters.center: World point [x, y, z] where the calibration anchor lands.
parameters.collection: Destination in the current scene. Default: create or use Hard Surface References.
parameters.image: An absolute path to a local still image.
parameters.pack_image: Pack the optional image into the blend.
parameters.preview_only: Return calibration and points without adding any scene objects.
parameters.roi: [left, top, right, bottom], normalized from the source image's upper left.
parameters.seed: Optional [u,v] inside the foreground, normalized from the source image's upper left. Default: keep the largest connected subject.
parameters.show_image: Create a co-registered Blender Image Empty.
parameters.simplify_px: Contour approximation distance in source pixels, default 1.5.
parameters.size: Positive [width, height] in Blender units. Use null for one dimension to retain image proportions.
parameters.threshold: Normalized alpha or luminance contrast. Defaults to .5 for alpha and .16 for luminance.

revolve.label: Revolve a profile with a live Screw modifier

parameters.closed: Join the last column or guide point back to the first without duplicating it.
parameters.collection: Destination scene collection; defaults to the anchor's single collection.
parameters.expected_signature: Required for updates. Use the previous operation's signature.
parameters.flip_normals: Reverse the winding of every quad. Keep it fixed for an in-place update.
parameters.landmarks: Ordered unique names for columns shared across sections (2–128).
parameters.name: Exact output object name. For an update, keep the existing name.
parameters.sections: Ordered {name, points} sections (2–64); world xyz BU, one point per landmark.

parameters.dimensional_tolerance_mm: Maximum absolute dimensional error in a section.
parameters.expected_preview_signature: Bind a commit to the recipe and shell from a previous preview.
parameters.expected_signature: Current signature required when updating a managed mesh.
parameters.gap_mm: Nominal bottom/outer-wall offset along the local outward axis.
parameters.gap_tolerance_mm: Maximum absolute error in the installation gap.
parameters.max_jump_mm: Maximum separation between adjacent projected samples.
parameters.max_normal_angle_deg: Maximum normal angle from the installation normal or previous hit.
parameters.min_clearance_mm: Minimum acceptable distance to the evaluated shell.
parameters.name: Managed output mesh object name.
parameters.outward_normal: Reference normal of the admissible installation side.
parameters.preview: Return validation report without mutating the scene.
parameters.profile: RECTANGLE uses width_mm, height_mm. PIPE uses outer_diameter_mm, wall_mm, and optional even sides.
parameters.sampling_mm: Maximum distance between projected guide samples (default 1.5).
parameters.stations: Ordered unique world-mm station records. Each has name, position_mm, locked, and optional corner (ROUND, STRAIGHT, MITER), radius_mm, or miter_limit_deg.
